bio: Located in the middle of a residential area in the south of Stuttgart, this gem is not easy to find but is well worth seeking out! Run with great dedication, the restaurant has a tasteful interior, and attentive service comes courtesy of an accomplished front-of-house team. But perhaps the main draw is the food served up by chef-patron Michael Huppert. His really innovative set menu cleverly integrates contrasts, with a focus on top-notch, predominantly regional produce. Tip: In summer, be sure to secure a spot on the delightful terrace to the side of the building....
